verdict.rationale: x402 includes a hosted CDP Facilitator service, so data residency is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence documents any way to choose a storage region or residency for facilitator, Bazaar or account data. Choosing a blockchain network (Base, Solana, and so on) or a receiving wallet is an adjacent control, not a data-residency choice, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
